13: // Re-check if the hook stops firing after an OpenCode upgrade changes these.

15: import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
16: import { homedir } from "node:os";

18: // Bumped in lockstep with .claude-plugin/plugin.json and this package's own
19: // package.json version by the release workflow — it's what pins which yul
20: // binary this plugin downloads and runs.
21: const YUL_VERSION = "0.0.17";
22: const CACHE_ROOT = join(process.env.XDG_CACHE_HOME ?? join(homedir(), ".cache"), "yul");
23: const CACHE_DIR = join(CACHE_ROOT, `v${YUL_VERSION}`);
24: const BIN_PATH = join(CACHE_DIR, "yul");

28: // notice, which has no obvious OpenCode-side equivalent to print to.
